snippet.title: Memoria Wake | Console Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the world of Memoria Wake. Get your first look at the relentless combat and unforgiving world coming to PC and Consoles, 2027.

Memoria Wake is a challenging action-RPG that demands precision and mastery. Face off against formidable foes, master the rhythm of battle to break your enemies' posture, and carve your path through a beautifully crafted, mysterious world.

Wishlist Memoria Wake today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3240610/Memoria_Wake/

Join our community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/VvEbKqNKmf
Twitter/X: https://x.com/MemoriaWake_
Website: https://www.memoria-wake.com/

Learn more about Team Crescendo!
https://www.team-crescendo.com/

#MemoriaWake #Xbox #indiegame #gaming #trailer
